goodToKnow: Obendrein means on top of that or into the bargain, often adding something annoying: Ich habe den Bus verpasst, und obendrein hat es geregnet. Synonyms: außerdem, zudem, noch dazu, darüber hinaus. It's from oben (above) and drein (into it). It sounds slightly old-fashioned or literary but is still common in writing. Stressed on the last syllable.
